integrity: A self-contained analytic proof plus a standalone exact-rational/high-precision diagnostic script are provided. No independent mathematical validation or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact all-scale claim restricted to volume-uniform 3D Euclidean unit ball and Euclidean testing balls with t>=1; a universal error constant for other distributions and dimensions is not asserted. Classical spherical lens calculation and general depth convergence preexist. Historical priority against unindexed equivalents remains uncertain.
title: Sharp finite-scale ball-depth error for the uniform three-ball
